Features

Everything Model Railroad Record Keeper does for your layout, on iPad and Mac.

On the App Store
Open a group, then click See it to see that screen with a picture and the details.
Operating Sessions (7)
  • Jobs list — Every switching, touring and delivery job in one filtered, sortable list.
  • Job builder — Steps, start and end tracks, the locomotive, and WiFi or throttle control.
  • Live operating board — Jobs move themselves from Unavailable to Available, Running and Finished.
  • Track locks — A job holding a track keeps conflicting jobs waiting until it clears.
  • Job rules — Available-when conditions and finish actions chain the session together.
  • Engineer assignments — Assign jobs from tonight's crew and print a run summary per engineer.
  • Job cards and schedule — Print the master job list, job cards and a full schedule.
Yard Office (10)▶ Overview video
  • Car Location — See which cars sit at every location, loaded or empty.▶ Video
  • Where's that car? — Find any car by number, road or description in seconds.
  • Car Locations report — Print every car's spot, grouped by track.
  • Routes — Set up a train run once: its start, its stops in order, its end and its locos.▶ Video
  • Your own route order — Group routes by type and drag them into the order you like.
  • Industry orders — Each industry asks for the cars it needs set out and picked up.▶ Video
  • Orders from Traffic — Fill an order from the industry's Traffic in one step.
  • Build Train — Pick a route, attach its orders or a Quick Switch List, and print the switch list.▶ Video
  • Dispatch — Mark each line Done or Not Done, record swaps, and Complete updates where every car sits.▶ Video
  • Quick Switch List — A short list of cars to move, from where each sits to where it goes, run as a train.▶ Video
Locomotives (5)
  • Roster with photos — Road number, railroad, model and DCC details at a glance.
  • Decoder details — Decoder, address, sound card, stay-alive and install notes.
  • F1–F32 labels — Label every function key, or auto-fill from the sound card.
  • CV settings — Keep the CVs you changed, ready for the next decoder reset.
  • Function Key Matrix — One printout of every engine's function keys.
Rolling Stock (5)
  • Car roster — Every freight and passenger car with photo, marks and type.
  • Full car record — Specs, couplers, NMRA weight, value and where you bought it.
  • Runner packs — One record can stand in for a set, so fleet counts stay true.
  • Custom column views — Save your own column layouts and print exactly what's on screen.▶ Video
  • Pivot table — Count or total your cars by type, road or year bought.
Car Cards & Waybills (6)
  • Car card designer — Four card sizes, your choice of fields, color bands by car type.
  • Card List — Queue cars, set copies, and see what's already been printed.
  • Fold-up waybill pocket — Each card can print with a pocket that folds up and tapes shut.
  • Waybills, 1 to 4 cycles — For any car of a type or one specific car.
  • Fold-over slips — Cut, fold and turn end-for-end. No duplex printer needed.
  • Make Waybills from Traffic — Pairs shippers with receivers and drafts the waybills.
Layout Signs (3)
  • Four kinds of sign — Station signs, industry placards, track tags and fascia cards, made from your Locations.
  • Design your own — Size, font, border and white-on-black, with a live preview.
  • Print in a batch — Pick the locations and copies, and finish a part-used sheet.
Locations & Traffic (5)
  • Locations list — Towns, yards and industries with track counts and siding totals.
  • Location detail — Tracks, buildings, devices, vehicles and figures for each place.
  • Industry traffic — What each industry ships and receives, by commodity and car type.
  • Turnouts — Accessory decoder, address and port behind every switch.
  • Location labels — Large-type labels with the location's tracks, ready to stick on.
Inventory (4)
  • Collection list — Structures, details and parts, three category levels deep.▶ Video
  • Item detail — Purchase history, value, photo, for-sale price and storage spot.
  • Pivot table — Total the collection by category, maker, location or year.
  • Reorder alerts — Items at or below their reorder level stand out in the list.
Reference & To-Dos (5)
  • Reference library — Manuals, decoder guides and wiring diagrams in one list.
  • Saved links and PDFs — Up to five links and an attached PDF for each piece of gear.
  • Built-in search browser — Find a manual on the web and save the link without leaving the app.
  • To-do list — Repairs, upgrades and someday ideas, tagged and prioritized.
  • Blog in the app — News, tips and how-tos, read right inside the app.
Your Railroad & Data (5)
  • More than one layout — Home road and club layout, kept separate and one tap apart.
  • Backup and restore — A full dated backup you hold, with Undo Last Restore.
  • JMRI import, Excel export — Bring rosters in from JMRI; send lists out to Excel.
  • Setup walkthrough — Numbered steps from an empty app to your first session.
  • iPad and Mac — One purchase covers both. No account, works fully offline.
Help & Support (3)
  • Extensive help — A ? help page on every screen, plus a searchable Help index.
  • Email support — Send a request from any screen, with screenshots and a support number.
  • Screen & report index — A printable list of every screen and report in the app.
